Five critical periods in sexual harassment
1. Prelude
2. Assault - escalating events
3. Limbo - period btwn assault & court, often years
4. Exposure - assault of victim’s reputation
5. Aftermath - ensure safety for victim when returning to work 
-Dr. Louise Stone
